transitions.operation_detail: Smartseq3_OligodT30VN anneals to the poly(A) tail and is extended by Maxima H Minus reverse transcriptase (NaCl instead of KCl, 5% PEG as crowding reagent)
terminal transferase activity of the MMLV-type reverse transcriptase adds untemplated C nucleotides to the cDNA 3' end

the rGrGrG end of Smartseq3_N8_TSO anneals to the untemplated Cs; the reverse transcriptase switches template and copies the TSO, appending the complement of the 11-bp tag and 8-bp UMI to the cDNA 3' end
cDNA amplification with Fwd_PCR_primer and Rev_PCR_primer, which also completes the second strand; subsequent purification of the amplified cDNA is folded into this transition

major_reagents.name: Nextera Tn5 transposome (s5 and s7 mosaic-end adapters)

transitions.operation_detail: Nextera Tn5 transposome tagments the amplified cDNA, leaving a 9-bp gap at each insertion; only fragments carrying different ends (s5/s7) are amplifiable, so the s5/s5 and s7/s7 products described in the legacy step are not carried forward
72 degree gap fill-in, the first cycle of the Nextera PCR
